summary: Russian forces continue missile and drone attacks across multiple Ukrainian regions while Ukrainian defenses report shooting down over 100 hostile UAVs. Active combat operations persist in eastern and northern front areas with ongoing threats of ballistic missile launches. Kazakhstan has deployed police posts to prevent fuel smuggling amid regional fuel price disparities.
key_points: Russian offensive directions reduced from 13 to 6-7 while maintaining plans to occupy Donetsk and Luhansk regions (Source: @UkraineNow/82543)
Ukrainian forces shot down 114 hostile UAVs including Shahed, Gerbera, and Italmas types from multiple directions (Source: @kpszsu/67924)
Russian shadow fleet lost 13 ships in one night, 48 total over five days according to Ukrainian military (Source: @UkraineNow/82554)
Kazakhstan established 59 police posts on Russian border to prevent illegal fuel exports amid price disparities (Source: @UkraineNow/82541)
Russian troops destroying gas stations in Kyiv region while reciprocal drone strikes continue along front lines (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31523)
Two settlements in Dnepropetrovsk region announced full resident evacuation due to ongoing threats (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31527)
Russian Iskander-M ballistic missiles threatened launch from Taganrog, Rostov region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68834)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces maintain capability for multi-domain attacks including ballistic missiles, tactical aviation, and UAV swarms despite reduced offensive directions. Ukrainian air defenses demonstrated effectiveness against 114 hostile UAVs but face continued threats from Iskander-M systems and guided aviation bombs. Regional fuel smuggling indicates economic warfare dimensions affecting border areas.
sections.regional_response: Kazakhstan deployed 59 police posts on Russian border to prevent illegal fuel exports amid significant price disparities. Ukrainian military continues defensive operations across multiple fronts with evacuation orders for threatened settlements. International responses include Slovenia rejecting military aid funding while Czech position remains unchanged.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian military showcased new Albatross-U kamikaze drone at Kazan exhibition indicating ongoing weapons development. Ukrainian monitoring reports reactive UAV activity across northern, eastern, and southern regions suggesting coordinated surveillance and strike campaigns. Fuel infrastructure attacks continue in Kyiv region while border smuggling prevention measures expand.
